key_insight: A high-fidelity iLES database was built to capture free-stream bypass transition more realistically than legacy experiments, exposing weaknesses in standard RANS transition models.
engineering_relevance: The dataset provides a stronger benchmark for designing and validating transition prediction methods used in aerodynamic and turbomachinery applications.
method: Wall-resolved implicit LES of flat-plate boundary-layer transition
Multiple freestream turbulence levels with zero and varying pressure gradients
Comparison against ERCOFTAC T3 experiment data and RANS transition models (SA-BCM, k-ω-γ)
evidence_signal: The simulations showed satisfactory agreement with experimental skin friction, mean velocity, and fluctuation profiles, while the database revealed systematic errors in transition onset and transition length predicted by SA-BCM and k-ω-γ.
watch_item: Because the database is based on controlled flat-plate conditions, transferability to more complex geometries and inflow environments still needs verification.
paper_title: A high-fidelity numerical database for free-stream transition
